subject.title: fix(tools): surface empty availability group diagnostics via onHiddenDiagnostic callback

question: Should this PR be accepted as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92361 with warn-only preservation of plugin-authored availability-like metadata?
rationale: The patch is technically sound from source review, but overlapping sibling PRs and the new warning interpretation for plugin-authored `availability`-like records require maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Accept this warn-only path
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix after refresh/rebase because it covers the planner callback, plugin registration wiring, and malformed metadata guards without changing returned tool resolution.

options.title: Choose a narrower sibling
options.body: Select another open PR if maintainers prefer a smaller planner-only or descriptor-registration-only implementation and close this PR after that path lands.

options.title: Request a different contract
options.body: Ask for a revised patch if maintainers want malformed plugin availability to filter tools rather than only warn, since that would be a stronger compatibility choice.

recommendation.title: Accept this warn-only path
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix after refresh/rebase because it covers the planner callback, plugin registration wiring, and malformed metadata guards without changing returned tool resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision centers on plugin descriptor-cache behavior and compatibility, where history points most strongly to this owner candidate.
